```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Load Dataset
input_file <- "C:/Users/cpeng/Downloads/archive/accident_details_compiled.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Automatically normalize column names (lowercase, replace special chars with underscores)
names(raw_data) <- tolower(gsub("[^[:alnum:]]+", "_", names(raw_data)))

# Initialize attrition tracking log
attrition_log <- tibble(
  Step = "0. Raw Dataset",
  Records = nrow(raw_data)
)

log_attrition <- function(step_name, data) {
  attrition_log <<- bind_rows(attrition_log, tibble(Step = step_name, Records = nrow(data)))
}


# 2. Date Parsing & Filtering (Sep 2002 - Dec 2024)
curated_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    parsed_date = parse_date_time(.data[["date"]], orders = c("ymd", "mdy", "dmy", "Ymd", "m/d/Y")),
    year = year(parsed_date),
    month = month(parsed_date)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(parsed_date),
    parsed_date >= ymd("2002-09-01") & parsed_date <= ymd("2024-12-31")
  )

log_attrition("1. Date Filter (Sep 2002 - Dec 2024)", curated_data)


# 3. Aircraft Type Restriction: Fixed-Wing Only
non_fixed_wing_regex <- "helicopter|rotorcraft|balloon|airship|glider|paramotor|ultralight|dirigible|autogyro|gyroplane"

curated_data <- curated_data %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(coalesce(.data[["ac_type"]], ""), regex(non_fixed_wing_regex, ignore_case = TRUE))
  )

log_attrition("2. Fixed-Wing Aircraft Isolation", curated_data)


# 4. Exclusion Criteria: anything non commercial
excluded_keywords_regex <- paste(
  c(
    "military", "air force", "army", "navy", "marines", "government", "state", "police",
    "cargo", "freight", "postal", "mail", "dhl", "fedex", "ups","USMC",
    "ambulance", "medevac", "medical",
    "training", "instruction", "test flight", "ferry", "positioning", "delivery",
    "firefighting", "survey", "mapping", "skydiving", "parachute", "crop dust", "agricultural",
    "private", "corporate", "recreational", "personal", "pleasure", "unauthorized"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

curated_data <- curated_data %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(coalesce(.data[["operator"]], ""), regex(excluded_keywords_regex, ignore_case = TRUE)),
    !str_detect(coalesce(.data[["summary"]], ""), regex(excluded_keywords_regex, ignore_case = TRUE))
  )

log_attrition("3. Mission & Operation Exclusions (Cargo, Military, Medevac, Private, etc.)", curated_data)


# 5. Passenger Manifest Filter: Exclude Zero-Passenger / Crew-Only Manifests
curated_data <- curated_data %>%
  mutate(
    total_aboard = parse_number(.data[["aboard"]]),
    is_crew_only = str_detect(.data[["aboard"]], "passengers:\\s*0")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(total_aboard),
    total_aboard > 0,
    is_crew_only == FALSE
  ) %>%
  select(-total_aboard, -is_crew_only) # Clean up temporary helper columns

log_attrition("4. Passenger Manifest Filter (Aboard > 0 & Non-Crew-Only)", curated_data)


# 6. Deduplication...if this is a word?
curated_data <- curated_data %>% distinct()
log_attrition("5. Deduplication & Final Polish", curated_data)

# Print Summary Table
cat("\n--- DATA CURATION ATTRITION SUMMARY ---\n")
print(attrition_log)

# Export Result
output_file <- "C:/Users/cpeng/Downloads/archive/commercial_passenger_fixedwing_accidents_2002_2024.csv"
write_csv(curated_data, output_file)

cat("\nSuccess! Saved curated dataset to:\n", output_file, "\n")
```
